results.title: Bloodholics Anonymous
results.overview: A group of famous vampires from fiction come together to meet in their local support group for those struggling with blood addictions, which just so happens to take place in the basement of a church, and is ran by the pastor's wife. Madness entails after they try to recount their experiences and bond with one another.

results.title: Blue Bicycle
results.overview: In a remote mountain village, Owraman, a quiet schoolteacher, sets out to give his late son’s bicycle to a student with albinism. But the bicycle is stolen along the way, passing from hand to hand through the village — and in its journey, it quietly connects the lives of the people who encounter it. Told as a poetic meditation on loss and connection, the film follows the bicycle’s path as much as the man who set it in motion.

results.title: Sanctuary
results.overview: Whilst hiding out in an old, rundown truck, a young girl who has run away from Sanctuary comes face to face with The Man. She has heard stories of him, but his intentions remain unclear.

results.title: Daar
results.overview: The story of a forester who encounters something strange while working.

results.title: Shut Up and Do
results.overview: With loan sharks close on their tails, a broke hustle-bro and his girlfriend break into a Beverly Hills mansion to film a get-rich-quick course.

results.title: Beetlejuice The Musical
results.overview: Lydia Deetz, a goth teenager grieving her mother's death, as she teams up with a recently deceased couple and a chaotic demon to navigate family, life, and the afterlife

results.title: Long Live Def Leppard
results.overview: A complete and all-access account of the epic journey Def Leppard has taken from its humble beginnings in the UK to a global fandom that continues to today.

results.title: Dead Eyes Behind the Painted Smile
results.original_title: Dead Eyes Behind the Painted Smile
results.overview: A twisted serial killer aims to satisfy his murderous blood-lust, donning a clown mask and pursuing a young theater worker and her friends. As the slasher slices and hacks his way through innocent victims, will Jenna survive the night? Award-winning cult horror filmmaker Joe Sherlock brings his relentless genre love to the killer clown world with grind house gore, eccentric characters and a throwback synthesizer score.

results.title: TEDE. Forever Rap
results.overview: TEDE. Forever Rap is an uncompromising portrait of Jacek "Tede" Graniecki – one of the most influential and controversial artists in the history of Polish rap. The film is driven by never-before-seen private archives from 1993–2002 – a priceless record of the years when hip-hop in Poland was just being born, with Tede and his crew at the very heart of that revolution. Twenty-two years after his first visit, the artist returns to the streets of New York on a sentimental journey, asking how he, Polish rap, Poland and America have changed.

results.title: Looking for the Expression of Tuileries' Firestarters
results.original_title: Recherches de l'Expression des Incendiaires des Tuileries
results.overview: More than 150 years after the destruction of the Tuileries Palace, how can we rediscover the materiality of the 1871 Paris Commune and its revolutionary fire ? Perhaps by exploring images of its ruins and by discussing with today’s militants...

results.title: The Turkey
results.overview: On the eve of his birthday, a man hides out in his apartment while recovering from a hair transplant and makes increasingly ridiculous excuses to avoid his friends. When they show up unannounced for a surprise celebration, he's forced to keep up the charade until his scalp starts bleeding, sending him into a meltdown.

results.title: ETTO
results.overview: Along the banks of the Nile in Giza, Egypt, a young street baller nicknamed “Etto” competes in neighborhood money matches to fund his injured friend’s surgery. A coming-of-age sports drama about brotherhood and redemption.

results.title: Calming Winds
results.overview: Struggling with his smoking addiction, Rich has to quit smoking before his partner Char leaves him. Searching on the internet for solutions he finds a peculiar pop up add that'll grant him his wish, by removing Rich's ability to create a flame.

results.title: Skag & Bone
results.overview: Younger is a 16-year-old rehoused with his mother, Maria, on the notorious Stonemore Estate. After a debilitating stroke leaves Maria unable to work, Younger is forced to become both provider and protector. While attempting to navigate an unforgiving world alongside his cousin Caleb, Younger is drawn into the orbit of local drug lord Anton, who offers protection, money and a possible escape from Stonemore, while an enigmatic local preacher presents a very different path. But as a violent gang war tightens its grip on the estate, residents begin disappearing without a trace. An entity known as the Skag & Bone Man stalks the blocks, feeding on fear, desperation and buried secrets. Trapped between encroaching criminal forces and a supernatural evil no one else will confront, Younger must fight to save his mother and survive long enough to escape.

results.title: Dear You
results.overview: Seo Lee-hyeon is a web novel writer who hides behind her cold, distant front while struggling to express her true emotions. One day, a bright and persistent young woman named Han A-rim enters her workspace under the guise of being a fan who lives nearby. As A-rim continuously breaks down Lee-hyeon's defensive walls with affectionate gestures and warm humor, a subtle intimacy begins to blossom between them.

results.title: Desiderata
results.overview: On a morning by the sea, a young man records reflections on his life when he’s interrupted by a missionary. Their conversation delves into themes such as guilt, faith, and choice.
